description: YouTube audio downloader and player for CardputerZero

store.summary: Download and play YouTube audio on your CardputerZero.
store.description: CardTube keeps a small library of YouTube channels. Add a channel with a link or @handle, browse its latest uploads, download the audio you like and play it right on the device. Downloaded videos are marked in the list, and the built-in player shows progress with play, pause, seek, previous and next. When a track ends it plays the next one automatically, downloading it first if needed; without internet it stays within the tracks you already downloaded.
